operations.description: Cluster 2 disclosed the uncovered routing risk in its own wording, so the batch-wide gate -- which greps for one canonical phrase -- did not see it. Same exact-string trap the taxonomy sweep hit: a disclosure that is real but unphrased consistently cannot be checked mechanically. The canonical sentence is added; the existing prose stays.
